title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode1 A Small Step Forward

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, you guys gotta hear this! Guess what?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We got a new offer for work!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you get to do this time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get to appear on a mini-segment for this online show, where we'll apparently showcase trending artists.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, this is incredible!
And just the other day, you were all asked to appear on that local radio program out in the country.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shizuku's commercial must be the reason why the offers are slowly starting to roll back in, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The person who got in touch with us said her commercial was the reason, so it's definitely been having a big impact.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You brought us back from the brink, Shizuku. That makes you our savior!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Savior might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... I'm so glad that my commercial has led to us receiving offers for work once again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I plan on continuing to do everything I can to make sure we get to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
There were moments when I genuinely believed that we'd stop receiving offers for good...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They are slowly starting to trickle back in.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
I'm still a bit puzzled...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Puzzled?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I am happy that we've started receiving offers again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the reason why we stopped receiving offers after Idol Lovers still remains a mystery.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
To be fair, in show business, it's rare for anyone to get steady work. We might've just had a lucky streak up until that point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's no doubting that we absolutely floored everyone at Idol Lovers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Exactly. That's why I'm still wondering...
Why did we suddenly stop receiving offers after that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we have started receiving offers again, but it's still a lot less compared to before we performed at Idol Lovers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I think we should keep investigating the root cause a little more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I should be being more positive since we just got a new offer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also believe that we each should be doing what we can right now. Saito and I will continue investigating this matter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let us know if you two ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can take care of coming up with ideas and writing scripts while you two investigate!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we start discussing our new offer...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Based on their proposal, we'll have a bit of time to talk about whatever we want, so we should use that chance to leave our mark!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Good work with today's meeting, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You too.
And thank you again for attending as well this time. Unfortunately, the others couldn't make it, so you were a big help...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That's okay. Times like these are what a manager is there for! Don't be afraid to ask me for anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're on our side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
With regards to that little dry spell of offers, did you learn anything on your end...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No... I tried asking people around the industry, but none of them were able to help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I even tried asking some of the staff we've worked with in the past between our meetings, but...)

rows.Speaker: Magazine Editor
rows.Line:
Huh? Rumors about MORE MORE JUMP!...?
H-Hmm... I can't say I have...

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Well... Each show does have a lot going on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No one seems to know...)

rows.Speaker: Magazine Editor
rows.Line:
O-Oh, look at the time!
I have to get to a meeting!

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Uhh... I need to help out over at my next set! Sorry, Haruka. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They were behaving a little oddly...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're going to meet with the others to do a stream after this, yes? I'll be stopping by the store to pick up a few things, so please go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Then, I'll see you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you again soon!
se_walk_women_001_1
A few hours later
MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, we'll have to wrap up today's stream here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for watching our “Full Body Workout ☆ Dance Lesson”, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We tried turning the moves to a well-known idol song into a workout track. What did you all think?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was tough, but it was also fun working out to a song I know!>
<I'm gonna be able to dance like Airi now...!>
<This song sounds so familiar. Where have I heard it before...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This song was used for a snack commercial back in the day. We decided to choose it because of its catchy beat and how popular it was back then!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I remember trying to copy the dance from this commercial when I was in elementary school! I really enjoyed our workout because it felt like such a huge blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that'd certainly explain why you didn't miss a single beat.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you nailed every move.>
<Oh, that commercial! Thank goodness you told us.>
<Speaking of commercials, I saw yours, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Some people are saying that they saw your commercial, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really?
It's wonderful to hear that so many people have seen it now.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <But... MORE MORE JUMP! isn't on TV as much anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, does this mean no more variety shows?>
<TV sorta hasn't felt the same lately without you girls.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... It's not always easy to make regular appearances since you need to know the right people and have a fair bit of luck.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We promise to let you all know if we do have anything planned, so stay tuned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also plan to spend more time on these streams to make up for less TV appearances.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we hope you'll all be looking forward to our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, showbiz can be pretty tough...>
<It's cool that you'll be doing more streams.>
<I'm gonna watch your next one in real time too!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, as much as we hate to do this, it's time to say farewell.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for all the comments, you guys!
Make sure to stretch so that you don't feel sore tomorrow, okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was a great workout, but I am a little scared about tomorrow.>
<My upper arms are already pretty sore...>
<The cost of exercising...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was a pretty intense workout, so please make sure to cool down properly, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks again for watching today.
See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some of our viewers have clearly noticed that we haven't been making as many appearances.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... We've started receiving offers again, but not nearly as many as before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is probably gonna worry them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If there's a reason behind all this, then we need to find out the truth.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we've already talked to just about everyone who we thought could tell us something.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The only person left is...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know I shouldn't ask him...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we don't have the luxury of keeping up appearances right now.)
